points.description: States that sizeof returns the size in bytes of its operand (the number of bytes the operand/type occupies in memory). Wording may vary, e.g. 'the number of bytes taken up by the operand' or 'memory size in bytes'.
points.partial_credit: Related statement that gives size or memory but not clearly bytes of the operand, or says it returns a size without saying what it measures.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that sizeof gives the size in bytes of its operand, in any wording, even briefly. Part marks (about half) for a related but incomplete statement, such as 'the size of a variable' with no mention of bytes, or 'memory used' with no link to the operand. No marks for talking about sizeof only in general terms, or for a wrong answer such as giving the value of the operand or the address of it.
